## Problem

What problem does this feature solve? Who experiences it, and in what situation?

## Proposed solution

A clear description of what you want to happen. Include user-facing behavior, not just implementation ideas.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why you set them aside.

## Phase fit

Which phase of the roadmap does this belong to (see README)? If you are not sure, leave blank.

## Additional context

Examples, references to similar features in other tools, mockups, or anything else useful.
